branch_assignments.rationale: Generalist VLA and hierarchical embodied-reasoning/control family.
Cross-embodiment world-action model used for physical prediction and policy loops.

paper.title: Gemini Robotics 2
paper.data: Undisclosed training mixture; official evaluation covers whole-body, dexterity, cross-embodiment and multi-robot tasks.
paper.method: Gemini-based VLA family with on-device control and ER 2 hierarchical embodied reasoning.
paper.task: Dexterous, whole-body, multi-stage and coordinated robot control.
paper.novelty: Combines whole-body control, cross-embodiment dexterity, local deployment and multi-robot orchestration.
paper.project_relevance: Reference for hierarchical VLA/ER decomposition and whole-body/multi-robot interfaces.

paper.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
paper.data: OXE, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM, G1 and egocentric human video.
paper.method: Latent-action physical-prior pretraining followed by end-effector grounding and few-shot adaptation.
paper.task: Predict action-conditioned futures across embodiments for planning and policy improvement.
paper.novelty: Reconciles heterogeneous actions with end-effector, language and latent-action interfaces.
paper.project_relevance: Open cross-embodiment dynamics and learned-simulator reference.

paper.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
paper.data: Single-image indoor/outdoor scenes, trajectories and long-video evaluations.
paper.method: PaSS Flow global 3D proxy plus video-diffusion appearance refinement.
paper.task: Generate controllable, explorable scene videos from one image.
paper.novelty: Uses a persistent generative 3D proxy to reduce long-horizon drift.
paper.project_relevance: Reference for persistent 3D memory and structure/appearance separation.

paper.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
paper.data: 50 physical scenarios across calibration and support-coverage tracks.
paper.method: Repeated rollout outcome mapping with separate support and probability-mass scoring.
paper.task: Evaluate the distribution of possible physical futures.
paper.novelty: Tests induced future distributions rather than isolated plausible videos.
paper.project_relevance: Adds explicit stochastic-world calibration and support fields.

paper.title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
paper.method: MemoryGain and NMR compare revisits with matched temporal controls.
paper.task: Evaluate persistent revisit memory without slow-motion shortcuts.
paper.novelty: Same-rollout relative calibration isolates revisit-specific consistency.
